newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen shares surge on takeover offer.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen shares surge on takeover offer.

text.p: Shares in German steel group Thyssen AG jumped on Tuesday after Fried. Krupp Krupp-Hoesch AG said it would offer 435 marks per Thyssen share.
The shares, which were suspended from regular trade but still changing hands in unofficial trade, leapt to a new high of 410 marks immediately after the news, dealers said.
That was some 65 marks above Thyssen's closing share price in Monday's bourse dealings.
"This is a solid price," said one dealer of the 435 marks per share offer, who forecast an enormous leap to around 400 marks in Thyssen shares once they resume official trade.
Dealers had been predicting an offer price of 430 to 450 marks.
Krupp shares, meanwhile, were at about 270 marks, two marks below their last official close on Monday.
